paragraphs: Mentioned in Nedarim, chapter 5, halakhah 5: Rabbi Shovtai and R' Chisda brought a case before R' Assi, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The exact corresponding Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 5:5 episode explicitly names Rabbi Shovtai, Rabbi Hasida and Rabbi Yose. Supplied Chisda and Assi remain unchanged; the full titles on the different named forms are not transferred to them. Shovtai’s matching occurrence supports Rabbi; Chisda and Assi remain R'.
פ״ה ה״ה explicitly gives chapter 5 halakhah 5. אעלון עובדא קומי means brought a case before, and etc. preserves Hyman’s truncated quotation without importing the case details.
